issues: 480×270 设计坐标放大，短语只占画宽 ~20%，进度条 150px、状态行 8px 级小字，整屏几乎全空
暗底 + 靛蓝的通用科技配色，切换故障只有轻微 RGB 毛边，"信号熔断"的冲击不够
四条短语之间没有上下文：看不出是在部署什么，结尾停在 READY TO SHIP 后也没有"完成"的落点
末条干净段只有十几帧，收尾 hold 偏短
changes: look 换成 aurora（深紫黑 · 紫 · 粉），原生 1920 作画：短语 104px 等宽大写占画宽 ~58%，四角细括号框住 17 格固定槽位，背后一条横向信号光带 + 极淡扫描线
故障由同一个 g 统一驱动并加码：粉 / 冰蓝 RGB 分离 g·10px、横向抖动 ±g·36px、g>0.25 水平撕裂带、g>0.45 像素块残影，每 2f 重掷
加部署控制台上下文：上方状态行（脉冲点 · DEPLOYING · halyard/web · #4127）、下方 1100px 进度轨（线性 + 四拍刻度 + 发光头）与 32px STEP / 百分比
收尾落点：末条收干净时给一次柔和泛光，进度满后状态转 DEPLOYED、点转实心，升起强调色链接「Live at halyard.build/web →」
节奏改为每条 38f、末条延续到片尾，干净 hold 从十几帧拉到 ~28f
issuesEn: Scaled up from 480x270 design space, the phrase covered only ~20% of the width, with a 150px progress bar and 8px-class status text, leaving the frame nearly empty
A generic dark-plus-indigo tech palette, and the switch glitch was only a faint RGB fringe without the punch of a signal meltdown
The four phrases had no context: you couldn't tell what was deploying, and ending on READY TO SHIP gave no sense of completion
The final clean stretch was only a dozen or so frames, so the closing hold was short
changesEn: Aurora look (deep violet-black, violet, pink), drawn natively at 1920: a 104px monospace caps phrase spans ~58% of the width inside 17 fixed slots framed by fine corner brackets, over a horizontal signal glow and faint scanlines
One g value drives every glitch, now stronger: pink / ice-blue RGB split at g*10px, horizontal jitter of +/-g*36px, a tear band above g 0.25 and pixel-block artefacts above g 0.45, re-rolled every 2f

Deployment-console context: a status row above (pulsing dot, DEPLOYING, halyard/web, #4127) and a 1100px progress rail below (linear, four beat ticks, glowing head) with 32px STEP and percent readouts
A real ending: when the last phrase clears it gets one soft bloom, and at 100% the status flips to DEPLOYED with a solid dot as the accent link 'Live at halyard.build/web ->' rises in
Each phrase now runs 38f and the last one carries to the end, stretching the clean hold from about a dozen frames to ~28f
